consultants.name: IDP Education Pakistan
consultants.summary: International education counselling provider offering Pakistan office appointments and virtual consultations.
consultants.destinations: Australia, Canada, UK, USA, Ireland and New Zealand. Confirm available institutions and courses with a counsellor.
consultants.services: Course and university selection, application guidance, student visa process guidance, and online counselling. IELTS information and booking are available through IDP IELTS.
consultants.office: Pakistan office network includes Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad, with additional city-specific virtual counselling links. Use the official office directory to choose a location and confirm its current address before visiting.

consultants.name: StudyIn Pakistan
consultants.summary: Overseas education consultancy, formerly SI-UK, with Pakistan offices and UK study guidance.
consultants.destinations: UK study is covered by the Pakistan website. Ask the local team which other destination services are currently available.
consultants.services: University and course guidance, application support and study-abroad counselling. Confirm the scope of visa and scholarship support for your chosen programme with the Pakistan team.
consultants.office: Lahore head office: Ehsan Plaza, 25 Block F-1, Second Floor, Khayaban-e-Firdousi, Johar Town, Lahore 54782. Its office directory also lists Lahore Faisal Town, Multan, Burewala and Gujar Khan.

consultants.name: Times Consultant
consultants.summary: Pakistan-based study-abroad consultancy with a nationwide office directory and international branches.
consultants.destinations: UK, Australia, Canada, USA, Germany, Ireland and other European and Asian destinations listed on its website.
consultants.services: Course selection, university applications, offer-condition guidance, student visa support, accommodation guidance and language services.
consultants.office: Karachi: 3/C, 2nd Floor, Khayaban-e-Sehar, DHA Phase 6. Lahore: 1st Floor, 68 Commercial, above Cakes & Bakes, Cavalry Ground. Islamabad: 3rd Floor, Malik Complex, Office 11, Jinnah Avenue, Blue Area. See the official directory for other branches.

consultants.name: HR Consultants Pakistan
consultants.summary: Overseas education consultancy with offices across Pakistan and guidance for several study levels.
consultants.destinations: UK, USA, Australia, Canada, Germany, New Zealand, Malaysia and UAE, with other destinations listed on its website.
consultants.services: University and course advice, document verification, admission support, visa assistance, interview preparation, pre-departure support and English-test preparation information.
consultants.office: Offices are listed in Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar, Faisalabad and Multan. Select the relevant branch on the official office page for its current address and appointment arrangements.

consultants.name: AEO Pakistan
consultants.summary: Study-abroad counselling provider that also publishes IELTS booking and preparation resources.
consultants.destinations: Australia, UK, USA, Canada, New Zealand, Malaysia and Dubai (UAE).
consultants.services: Destination and university selection, admission and visa guidance, scholarship assistance, accommodation and post-arrival support information, plus IELTS testing and preparation.
consultants.office: Islamabad DHA: Plaza 26, Main Iqbal Boulevard, Sector A Commercial, DHA Phase 2. Lahore Gulberg: House 50-C-III, Gulberg III. Karachi Clifton: Office 601, 6th Floor, Razi Tower, BC-13, Block 9. More branches are listed on its contact page.
consultants.phoneNote: Islamabad DHA admissions and visa information.

consultants.name: P2GS — Pakistan to Germany Study
consultants.summary: Education consultancy focused on German study pathways and German-language preparation.
consultants.destinations: Germany is the main focus; its website also lists selected programmes in Hungary, Switzerland, Türkiye, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan.
consultants.services: Bachelor’s and master’s pathway information, university application and visa support, German-language preparation from A1 to B2, and information on nursing, medical and other study routes.
consultants.office: Islamabad head office: Venture Universal Trade Plaza, 20 Street 26A, Sector H, DHA Phase II, Lavender Road, Islamabad 44000. Lahore: House 24A, Street 4, Amir Town, Harbanspura. Karachi: Ocean Towers, Block 9, Clifton 75600.
